title: Netanyahu Has Reinvented Himself. Will Voters Think It’s Enough?
summary_full: The Oct. 7 attacks marred Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s image as Mr. Security. Ahead of elections, he’s trying to sell Israelis on the new, hawkish version of himself.
